title: Human in the loop workflow
caption: The source-to-quiz workflow: three stages from a source to a quiz and a reusable skill, a fresh chat for each job, and you check every artifact in between.

readme.heading: Read me
readme.shows: The source-to-quiz Workflow in its Stages view: three stages from a goal to a quiz and a reusable skill, one card each.
readme.tryit: Click a stage to open its Practice it window and copy its prompts into a fresh AI chat. Pick another use case in the toolbar.
readme.notice: The checked mark on a card says a person reviews that result before the next stage starts.

workflow.header: The Explorable explanation in its own words
workflow.description: The AI attention span episode shows this Workflow with that Slide's own words on top. Here it keeps its defaults: the source-to-quiz Workflow, the other use cases one pill away, every "Try it" open.
